findings.rationale: Platform quality gate `solvable` (pre-panel), filed on the reference axis. Targets were the best of hours of 8-core multi-seed search while the agent has 2 CPUs; cold-start runs of the reference search at the agent budget (2400 s, one core, seeds 2/3/4) missed the old target in 12/12 runs. Targets are now the dearest of those three runs per morning, solve.sh and the explanations state that budget, the instruction no longer calls targets best-known, agent timeout 5400->10800 s, expert estimate 6->4 h. The shipped planner stays 41-49% over (or infeasible).

gate.not_mechanizable: reachability of an optimisation target needs a timed reference run at the agent budget; recorded in AGENTS.md best-known-target rule
